target.title: Queue attention request handoffs
target.body:
Closes #9
## Summary

Fixes a race where rapid `nameplate attention ...` invocations could overwrite the single shared `attention.json` handoff file before the app consumed it.

Attention requests now write to a queue directory using unique timestamp/UUID filenames. The app drains queued requests deterministically and still consumes the legacy `attention.json` path for migration compatibility.

The app-side display path now keeps an in-memory queue and shows attention alerts sequentially, so draining multiple files does not immediately replace earlier alerts.

## Verification

- `swift build`
- `git diff --check`

Direct proof against the built `NameplateCore` module:

```text
PROOF files-after-write count=2 names=attention-1800000000000000-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001.json,attention-1800000000001000-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002.json
PROOF consumed count=2 messages=first,second
PROOF files-after-consume count=0
```
